name: MaledictioN
source:
You, priest, have been sent by the Vatican to find the reason for the evil that is eating away at your homeland. So, what could have possibly happened here, and above all... who could have caused so much misery?! It's up to you to find out.

The world is dying, the end is near. Yet, you have been chosen to save it, even though it holds no cure to be healed. This mission is doomed to fail. Still, you are here.

The sky is red, heavy with blood; the earth is barren and blighted; animals and plants alike are rotting; and the people inhabiting these lands of old France seem to be adapting—whether out of sheer madness or pure survival. Something is wrong here, and you know that perhaps you—a priest—might find the solution. 

[From [url=https://stray-distance.itch.io/malediction]itch.io[/url]]
